method: Read-only inspection by root and explorer; no implementation or runtime behavior test in this review

findings.claim: Six research navigation entries and three reference-panel modes are active.
Paper search is a separately submitted form; candidate discussion/import/placement actions are separate.
Card and drawing modes conditionally render two work surfaces; shared cards are shown in drawing but free drawing stays hidden in card layout.
There are existing chat board proposals and shared services; a general research tool execution loop is not delivered by those feature buttons.
Existing workbench navigation redesign remains a proposal, not implemented behavior.
